API_BASE_URL = os.getenv("API_BASE_URL")

USERNAME = os.getenv("APP_USERNAME")
PASSWORD = os.getenv("APP_PASSWORD")

BASE_PATH = os.getenv("BASE_PATH", "")

USE_MOCKUP = os.getenv("USE_MOCKUP", "false").lower() == "true"

    API_BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8002"

# -----------------------------
# Auth Layer (Authlib)
# -----------------------------
class AuthManager:
    def __init__(self, base_url: str):
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.token_url = f"{self.base_url.replace('/api', '')}/auth/signin"
        self.refresh_url = f"{self.base_url.replace('/api', '')}/auth/refresh"

        self.client = AsyncOAuth2Client()
        self.access_token: Optional[str] = None
        self.refresh_token: Optional[str] = None

        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def signin(self, username: str, password: str):
        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
            resp = await client.post(
                self.token_url,
                json={"id": username, "password": password},
                timeout=10,
            )

        if resp.status_code != 200:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Signin failed: {resp.text}")

        data = resp.json()
        self.access_token = data["accessToken"]
        self.refresh_token = data["refreshToken"]

        self.client.token = {
            "access_token": self.access_token,
            "refresh_token": self.refresh_token,
        }
